Variable Variable.reasoning: This column lists the variables or terms being defined in the data dictionary.

Abundance coeff..reasoning: This column contains the calculated coefficient values for abundance.

Abundance SE.reasoning: This column contains the standard error values associated with abundance coefficients.

Abundance p.reasoning: This column contains the p-values for the abundance measurements.

Occurrence coeff..reasoning: This column contains the calculated coefficient values for occurrence.

Occurrence SE.reasoning: This column contains the standard error values associated with occurrence coefficients.

Occurrence p.reasoning: This column contains the p-values for the occurrence measurements.

Species richness coeff..reasoning: This column contains the calculated coefficient values for species richness.

Species richness SE.reasoning: This column contains the standard error values associated with species richness coefficients.

Species richness p.reasoning: This column contains the p-values for the species richness measurements.
